desc:
Watch 200+ nations grow, ally, fight and collapse on their own, or take control and steer them, Start in different eras, from the Roman Empire to the Cold War. Use god powers: nukes, meteors, floods, volcanoes, revolts and more. Command armies of flag troops along the front lines. Paint your own maps in the private Map Editor. Host your world so friends can join and watch, and share worlds with the community. Level up, earn coins and unlock new maps, powers and Battlepass rewards

Original concept inspired by Ages of Conflict 
Made with ❤️ by Nwtaken & Gamboss.
